newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BAYERN MUNICH V BORUSSIA DORTMUND FACTS/FIGURES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER SHOWCASE-BAYERN MUNICH V BORUSSIA DORTMUND FACTS/FIGURES.

text.p: Facts and figures for Sunday's German first division match between Bayern Munich and Borussia Dortmund:

Major honours: European champions 1974, 1975, 1976, European Cup Winners' Cup winners 1967, UEFA Cup winners 1996. Record German champions 1932, 1969, 1972, 1973, 1974, 1980, 1981, 1985, 1986, 1987, 1989, 1990 1994, German Cup winners 1957, 1966, 1967, 1969, 1971, 1982, 1984, 1986.
Record goal scorer: Gerd Mueller (365 in 427 games)
Major honours: European Cup Winners' Cup Champions 1966, German champions 1956, 1957, 1963, 1995, 1996. German Cup winners 1965, 1989.
Record goal scorer: Manfred Burgsmueller (135 in 224 games) 1976-83
Bayern Munich v Borussia Dortmund league record:
Bayern 11 Borussia Dortmund 1, Munich, 17 November 1971 (Bayern's largest ever victory)
Last 10 seasons in Munich from 1986-87 (Bayern score first) 2-2, 1-3, 1-1, 3-0, 2-3, 0-3, 2-0, 0-0 2-1 1-0
Corresponding match last season: March 30, 1996. Bayern Munich 1 (Mehmet Scholl 38th minute) Borussia Dortmund 0. Attendance 63,000 (capacity)

Bayern then struck a psychological blow in title race with a victory which put them on top of the table two points ahead of Dortmund. Scholl struck a superb lob for the winner but win was marred after the German international midfielder struck a Dortmund player after the final whistle in front of millions of television viewers.
